show.description: When a devastating house fire forces a man to choose between saving his trapped wife or his injured nanny, his decision to save the nanny sets off a chain of irreversible consequences,leading to his wife’s death, exposing buried emotional betrayals, and driving his daughter into a relentless fight to uncover the truth and make him pay for his choices.
